### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/plugin-security`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **72** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/index.ts`, `packages/spec/liveness/README.md`, `packages/spec/liveness/permission.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**19** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e4ec6ec1a5eff818d69e5bdf1ae031f37fec64bd`.

⛔ **12** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/index.ts`, `packages/spec/liveness/README.md`, `packages/spec/liveness/permission.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **12** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **145** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e4ec6ec1a5eff818d69e5bdf1ae031f37fec64bd` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `c9223036787f188bf64d25bddffd880644d17942` — the merge of head `31262798277b1394e4be1401e6a6f5fad974f67c` into base `e4ec6ec1a5eff818d69e5bdf1ae031f37fec64bd`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin c9223036787f188bf64d25bddffd880644d17942 && git checkout c9223036787f188bf64d25bddffd880644d17942
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin e4ec6ec1a5eff818d69e5bdf1ae031f37fec64bd 31262798277b1394e4be1401e6a6f5fad974f67c && git checkout -B drift-repro e4ec6ec1a5eff818d69e5bdf1ae031f37fec64bd && git merge --no-ff 31262798277b1394e4be1401e6a6f5fad974f67c

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e4ec6ec1a5eff818d69e5bdf1ae031f37fec64bd
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs e4ec6ec1a5eff818d69e5bdf1ae031f37fec64bd` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `accde78fe683b6de16a301941ede9a5052f09c9c`
Local-runs: none

PR #23368 (`claude/issue-22975-7a-recut`, draft, opened 2026-10-14T02:23Z), #22975 slice 7a. Read: the PR body with its `## 维护者速读（草稿）`, the 28-file list, the three-dot diff against `origin/main` (merge base `18cd410dc4`; +336 / −6,516), the merge ref `refs/review/pr-23368-merge` = `007555b320` (parents `dc393266fd` and the head), the 41 check-runs on the head, the nine card comments the brief names, #23308 and PR #23334 (`6d96721faa`, an ancestor of the head), and ADR-0131, ADR-0087 and ADR-0094 on `origin/main` `713f231854`. **No 7a `os-dev-report` is on #22975**: at 2026-10-14T03:24Z the newest comment after the resume dispatch 6157825993 is the dispatch itself. The body says the head's full re-run is "in progress" and its counts "go in the os-dev-report", so the head is weighed on the body and the check-runs, as the brief allows. Every local figure quoted from the body (suite counts, dogfood, the gate sweep, the ablation) is the dev's unposted claim on `bb4760b9ba`, not on this head; nothing here was re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

**Dead before deletion — holds.** On `origin/main`, outside the three modules themselves, the only code importers are: `index.ts` (the re-exports, removed), `packaged-permission-set-overlay-detection.ts` (`tryFind`, `ProjectionLogger`; re-homed), and the tests this PR deletes or re-pins (`packaged-permission-set-lock.test.ts`, `packaged-permission-set-overlay-detection.test.ts` for `permissionSetRowFields`, `engine-find-bare-array.pin.test.ts` for `buildExistingByName`). `security-plugin.ts` imports nothing from them since S8; `security-catalog-echo.ts` (#23308) imports only `organization-scope.js` and `packaged-permission-set-lock.js`. The 11 entry exports are used by nothing outside `plugin-security` in any package (only comments, pending changesets and docs name them). On the head tree no import of `permission-set-projection.js`, `seed-name-lookup.js` or `seed-refusal-sink.js` remains anywhere; `Type Check · workspace` is green. `tryFind` is re-homed as a private helper of the overlay detection (same `catch → []` contract, reading as the system through `seedCtx()`), with a new pin in its test that a refused read answers nothing and that both type spellings are asked under the page cap. `ProjectionLogger` is not re-homed: `OverlayDetectionOptions.logger` now asks for `{ warn }` only; that is a published type (`index.ts` exports `OverlayDetectionOptions`), and the change widens what a caller may pass (every old `ProjectionLogger` still satisfies it), so nothing compiled against it breaks. The `writesExecutedByDataDoor` stand-down removed from the security middleware had no `.add` caller left on `main` (only the declaration and the `.has` read), so its removal changes no behaviour. **objectui pinned sibling: NOT MEASURED** — see ③.

**The package entry — disposition present and right; level right.** The entry loses 7 runtime exports (`permissionSetRowFields`, `permissionSetBodyFromRow`, `upsertEnvPermissionSet`, `projectPermissionMutation`, `registerPermissionSetProjection`, `createPermissionSetWriteThrough`, `reconcilePermissionSetProjection`) and 4 types (`PermissionSeedOutcome`, `ProjectionDeps`, `ProjectionReconcileOutcome`, `WriteThroughDeps`): 11, as the body says. `.changeset/15204-7a-permission-set-projection-retired.md` carries the adr-0087 `not-required (runtime-export-retired …)` marker naming all 11 as `@objectstack/plugin-security#Name`, the ADR-0087 seventh category (addendum 2026-10-12), with a why that states no metadata moves. Each retired name has an arrowless `- FROM … TO …` line, the shape the addendum prescribes; the one non-trivial TO, `permissionSetBodyFromRow` → `permissionSetDefinitionFromRow` from `@objectstack/core`, resolves (`packages/core/src/security/permission-set-row-definition.ts`, re-exported through `security/index.ts` and the root). The level is `minor` with the BREAKING banner, the `!` in the PR title and `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`; under the WHICH LEVEL rule and the launch-window convention in `pr-automation.yml` (breaking-ness carried by the banner plus the ADR-0087 disposition, `major` refused by `check-changeset-no-major`) that is the right grade. `Check Changeset` is green on the head. `@objectstack/spec` is `patch` — right for a liveness-evidence edit — but see the liveness item below: the changeset's spec sentence is not yet true.

**The deletion clause — holds for the five deleted suites; two sub-cases of still-live code are left without a direct pin (noted, not blocking).**
- `permission-set-projection.test.ts` (1,886): every describe targets a deleted function (`permissionSetBodyFromRow`, `upsertEnvPermissionSet`, `projectPermissionMutation`, `registerPermissionSetProjection`, `createPermissionSetWriteThrough`, `reconcilePermissionSetProjection`, `mergeRowPatchIntoBody`). Its #21789 echo-stamp cases (lines 454 and 471 on `main`) and the echo-heal and boot-echo cases are pinned by #23308's `security-catalog-echo.test.ts` (the two #21789 cases re-homed, the legacy-overlay control re-cut as "a name the registry already serves is not echoed", drop/skip and the boot pass), which 7a does not touch. Nothing #23308 pins is deleted: its suite and `security-catalog-echo-env-kernel.integration.test.ts` import no deleted module.
- `permission-set-projection-heal-by-id.test.ts`, `packaged-permission-set-restore-leg.test.ts`, `permission-set-duplicate-name-refusal.test.ts`: each pins only `createPermissionSetWriteThrough` or `reconcilePermissionSetProjection` behaviour (the data door's restore leg, its 409, the boot heal) — deleted code.
- `seed-name-lookup-degradation-audible.test.ts`: `buildExistingByName` and `reportThroughSink` only — deleted code.
- `engine-find-bare-array.pin.test.ts`: blocks 1 and 2 (seed-name-lookup's batched page and per-item read) removed; the header now says two pins and names the retired blocks; blocks 4 and 5 and their `engine-double-contract.pinned.json` rows stay.
- `packaged-permission-set-lock.test.ts` (−719 / +53): the dropped pins 1, 2, 3, 5 and controls A and B all ran through `registerPermissionSetProjection` + the data-door middleware, i.e. deleted code. What they also exercised in live code is re-pinned: the classifier's registry-only reading (the new `makeQl` has no `find` at all, so a re-route through a table read goes red by construction), the metadata door accepting a runtime-package set and refusing a code-shipped one with 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, the `userMessage` envelope through `resolveThrownHttpError`, and the fail-closed sibling when both the registry and the layered read throw. `packaged-permission-set-lock-gate.test.ts` on `main` pins the door end to end, including "no provenance source can answer → refused". Left without a direct pin after 7a: (i) the classifier's *non-list* registry answer (`listItems` returning `undefined`, old pin 5 case 2; the `Array.isArray` branch at `packaged-permission-set-lock.ts:221` still exists), and (ii) the dispatcher-door resolution of the lock's throw as its own case (the new suite resolves it inside the two `userMessage` cases, so it is covered, not named). Neither is deleted behaviour; (i) is a one-case gap worth a follow-up.

**The zero-row acceptance — pinned; the ablation is a measurement on another tree, reported only in the body.** `packages/cli/test/permission-set-zero-row.integration.test.ts` boots the host shape and the environment shape (`ObjectQLPlugin({ environmentId, registerProtocol: false })` + `createMetadataProtocolPlugin`, the real `MetadataPlugin`, `AuthPlugin`, `SecurityPlugin`) over a fresh SQLite file; does a package-door draft + `publishPackageDrafts` and a writable base's `mode: 'publish'` save; asserts non-vacuity (both names stored as active env-wide `sys_metadata` rows); counts `sys_permission_set` through the test's own connection (missing table = 0); reboots over the stored definitions and counts again; and a control creates the table, writes one row and reads one. That is the epic's three legs (6129253247, adopted 6129999436) on both kernels. The "writer put back" is S8's parent `99e944daf2`, where the body reports both kernels red (`expected 2 to be +0` after the publishes, and again after the boot). That is a legitimate red with the writer present, but it is a dev measurement in the PR body, not in an os-dev-report, and not re-runnable here. CI ran the file: with `OS_TEST_TIERS: queue` the `packages/cli` population is every file not named `.e2e`/`.live`, and the `integration` project collects it by its signals; the six `Test Core` shards are green on the head.

**The liveness registry — NOT retired. This is the blocking finding.** The entry Q3 → B retires at 7a (seat review 6124054616: "the liveness registry's `permission-set-projection` entry … its dangling `proofRef` is invisible to every gate") lives in `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/proof-registry.mts` (`HIGH_RISK_CLASSES`, lines 202–222 on `main`): `id: 'permission-set-projection'`, `proofRef: 'packages/qa/dogfood/test/showcase-permission-projection.dogfood.test.ts#permission-set-projection'` — a file that does not exist on `main` — with a summary that still describes the data-door write-through and the awaited projection as present machinery. The diff does not touch that file. It removes only the README's mirror row (`packages/spec/liveness/README.md` line 531) and the `tabPermissions` evidence pointer in `permission.json`. The README states twenty lines above that row that "`proof-registry.mts` is the source of truth; the tables below mirror it", so after this PR the mirror contradicts its source. The dispatch's spelling "the entry in `packages/spec/liveness/permission.json`" was imprecise — `permission.json` has no such entry, only the evidence citation that 7a did fix — but the seat review and the body's own words ("the README's registered-but-unbound … proof row retires with the invariant") make the intent plain, and the "registered" half is still true: it is still registered. Nothing else holds the id (no `@proof` tag under `packages/qa/dogfood/test/`, no `ledgerBindings`, no fixture in `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/`), and `proof-registry.test.ts` validates `proofRef` only for bound classes, so deleting the entry is a one-hunk change under the `@objectstack/spec` patch already declared; the changeset's spec sentence and the body's liveness bullet then become true. `Spec property liveness` is green on the head exactly because the dangling ref is gate-invisible — which is why the seat put it on 7a's acceptance.

**D's transitional text — removed; known-limitation item 3 is stated nowhere in the repo after this PR.** `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx` on `main` carries no transitional `managedBy:'admin'` sentence: #23322 (`4d4040ccb6`) removed the "Until stage 7 retires the ADR-0094 projector …" Package-door text and the admin-door bullet's transitional row; the current Package-door bullet reads "no row is written for it", the admin door "No row mirrors it". The body's claim that nothing was left to change there is true. The dogfood header of `package-uninstall-revokes-named-grants.dogfood.test.ts` now says no seeder, materializer or projector writes a row. Item 3 (6139333945 on #15204; ruling 2 in 6145194655) is stated in that GitHub comment, in #23227's card text, and in the pending changeset `.changeset/23233-permission-echo-names-runtime-package.md` ("Unchanged. The `sys_permission_set` row (still `managed_by: 'admin'`, with no `package_id`)"); all three become false at landing — see ③.

**Regenerated files — consistent with the diff, and CI-verified on the merge tree.** Census: the three `permission-set-projection.ts` sites (insert `object`, update `object`, delete `sys_permission_set`) leave; 226 → 223, decidable 153 → 152, undecidable 73 → 71, `UNTYPED_RECEIVERS`-placed 6 → 5, `object: string`-placed 7 → 5, and the prose figures in `tenant-audit-census.mdx` follow; the `UNTYPED_RECEIVERS` row in `scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs` is removed. `check-tenant-audit-census` runs in `Lint · repo & tooling gates` — green. The stamp reads `bb4760b9b`, the pre-merge commit, and the gate passed on the merge with `dc393266fd`, so the counts hold on the tree CI judged. `engine-double-contract.pinned.json` loses the rows of the lock suite's gone engine double (3), the restore leg (2), the duplicate-name suite (2) and the projection suite (1); the baseline loses the projection suite's two DEBT rows; `objectql-double-limit.baseline.json` loses the restore leg and the projection suite — each a deleted suite or the re-pinned one. Those gates run in `Lint · ESLint` (`check:engine-double-contract`) and `Lint · CI, release & engine gates` (`check:objectql-double-limit`) — green. `system-context.mdx` row 11 (the projection middleware skip, anchored into the deleted file) is removed; the table already tolerated gaps (no row 14). `scripts/measure-durability-swallow-family.mjs` drops its `POSITIVE_CONTROLS` entry for the file (leaving one stray blank line). The ADR-anchor JSON for the file is deleted; the three symbol-anchor sweeps run in `Lint · docs & code guards` — green, so no ADR line anchors into the deleted file, as the body says.

**Published text the change makes false.** Corrected here: `system-context.mdx` row 11, the `tabPermissions` evidence, the dogfood header, the census pages. Carried by name in the body: ADR-0094 (its "Implementation:" line 398 and the suite at line 188 still name the files; its status line already records the stage-8 retirement via #23362), and "surviving comments" to 8-post's sweep. Not corrected and not named: ADR-0126 (the "Three real mechanisms" list cites `permission-set-projection.ts` for the #4669 row-state ruling), ADR-0131 (the Consumers line 59 and the dated code list at line 993); the spec docblocks `permission.zod.ts:824`, `metadata-plugin.zod.ts:1166`, `error-code-ledger.zod.ts:1270`; `scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs:156`; and the platform-checklist item whose `source` string names the file (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/access-security.json:2649`). #23362's diff touched none of these lines. All are prose pointers; none is gate-bearing. They belong with the seat's ADR-0094 card or 8-post's sweep — see ③.

**The 维护者速读（草稿）, statement by statement.** True: the scope and size (28 files, +336 / −6,516; about 6,500 lines); the new integration test and its three legs on a fresh database; "stage 8 left the projector without a caller" (true of the code; the one live behaviour, the echo, is correctly attributed to #23308); "no behaviour change for a running deployment" (the stand-down removal is unreachable code, the three modules unwired); 11 exports removed, compile failure for a direct importer, a FROM → TO per name; whole-PR revert with no data migration; Tier H by line count; the seat-opinion part empty. **Not true in the body outside the 速读:** (1) "objectui pinned sibling … CI's Console Pin Gate covers it" — the `console-pin` job's `if:` excludes `pull_request` and `merge_group` events (full battery only, #22998), and on this head it is **skipped**; it covers the import after landing, not before, and nothing in this PR's checks measured objectui. (2) "the README's registered-but-unbound `permission-set-projection` proof row retires with the invariant" — the README row is gone; the registration is not. The 速读's own sentences are all true of the diff.

**Check-runs on the head (the gate verdicts).** 41, all completed by 2026-10-14T02:56Z; none running. 36 success: the six `Test Core` shards and the aggregate, `Build Core`, `Build Docs`, every `Lint ·` and `Type Check ·` job, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `Spec property liveness`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Part-of PR must not also close its card`, the claim and single-writer checks, `Check Documentation Links`, `Auto Label`, `Flag docs affected by code changes`, `filter`. 5 skipped, all full-battery-only: `Console Pin Gate`, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `Temporal Conformance`, the `Dogfood Regression Gate` shards (the aggregate reads success with its matrix skipped), `Packed-tarball smoke`. No commit statuses. The body carries no closing keyword (`Refs #22975`; the commits carry none either).

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/plugin-security`: **`minor`**, with the BREAKING banner, the `!` title and the adr-0087 `not-required (runtime-export-retired …)` marker over all 11 names — the launch-window grade for retiring published runtime exports (WHICH LEVEL in `pr-automation.yml`; `major` refused by `check-changeset-no-major`; breaking-ness carried by banner plus disposition, not level). `@objectstack/spec`: **`patch`** — the right level for the liveness edits, once the registry entry is actually removed. No level is wrong; the spec sentence in the changeset is currently a description of work not done.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Blocking (acceptance Q3 → B):** `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/proof-registry.mts` still carries the `permission-set-projection` class with its dangling `proofRef`; only the README mirror row was removed. One hunk, no other file names the id; re-review the new head.
- **Body correction required:** the objectui pinned-sibling sentence names a check that does not run on pull requests. The honest line is: not measured on this head; `main`'s full battery runs `Console Pin Gate` after landing; the retired names are server-side plugin functions and types. **objectui itself: NOT MEASURED** — no sibling checkout exists here, and the REST door to `objectstack-ai/objectui` is not enabled for this session.
- **No os-dev-report for the head.** The body's verification is on `bb4760b9ba` (with `6d96721faa` merged in); for `accde78fe6` it promises the counts later. Dogfood (256 files) and the derived gate sweep (120 derived, 119 run) are local claims, since PR CI runs no dogfood (#22998). The seat decides whether to wait for the report before the maintainer is asked.
- **Merge ref drift:** `refs/review/pr-23368-merge` merges with `dc393266fd`; `origin/main` is six commits on at `713f231854`. None of the six touches the PR's surface (overlap: `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` only). GitHub reports `mergeable: clean`.
- **Known-limitation item 3 at landing:** 6139333945 on #15204 (the epic PM's), #23227's card text, and the pending `.changeset/23233-permission-echo-names-runtime-package.md` "Unchanged … still `managed_by: 'admin'`" line all become false the moment 7a lands in the same `next` prerelease. The changeset line is the one in the repo; the seat may want it corrected as a pending-note correction, or named in 7a's body.
- **Prose that names the deleted file, not carried by name:** ADR-0126 "Three real mechanisms", ADR-0131 Consumers (line 59) and code list (line 993), the three spec docblocks, `check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs:156`, `access-security.json:2649` `source`. Suggest the seat's ADR-0094 card at landing takes the ADR lines, and 8-post's comment sweep the rest.
- **Pin gap, non-blocking:** the classifier's non-list registry answer (`listItems` returning a non-array → `unknown` → refused) loses its only direct pin with old pin 5; the throw variant stays pinned in both the lock suite and the lock-gate suite.
- **Ablation shape:** the "writer put back" is S8's parent tree, not an in-tree writer on the head; acceptable as a measured red, and the control case makes the counter non-vacuous, but it rests on the body's word.
- **Out of scope, pre-existing:** `packages/spec/liveness/permission.json` line 20 (`permission.description` evidence) still cites the S8-retired `sys-permission-set.object.ts`; `.changeset/23233-*` as above; `check:platform-checklist` is maintainer-run by hand, not CI (lint.yml 2607–2612), so its "8 pre-existing reds" is the dev's reading.
- **NOT MEASURED here, by the read-only shape:** the local suite counts, the dogfood run, the gate sweep, the ablation on `99e944daf2`, the platform checklist, the objectui imports.

Adopted by `domain:engine` seat 2 at 2026-10-14T03:29Z, after a tool-use audit of the isolated reviewer's transcript. The reviewer made reads, `git fetch` into review refs, REST GETs, and record writes only. It made no GitHub write and ran no build, test or gate. The seat takes the verdict as FAIL and sends one patch round:
- **Item 1, blocking:** remove the `permission-set-projection` entry from `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/proof-registry.mts`, the source of truth for the README row already removed.
- **Item 6:** re-home the classifier's non-list registry answer pin (`packaged-permission-set-lock.ts`), because the deletion clause keeps a live behaviour pinned.
- **Item 4, the in-repo half:** correct the pending `.changeset/23233-permission-echo-names-runtime-package.md` line, which 7a makes false.
- **Item 2:** the body says objectui is NOT MEASURED; Console Pin Gate does not run on a PR.
- **Item 3:** the round's `os-dev-report` lands on the new head.
- **Item 4, the out-of-repo half:** comment 6139333945 on #15204 and #23227's card text are corrected by the seat at landing.
- **Item 5:** the ADR prose (ADR-0126, ADR-0131 lines 59 and 993, ADR-0094) goes to the governed ADR card the seat files at landing. The spec docblocks (`permission.zod.ts:824`, `metadata-plugin.zod.ts:1166`, `error-code-ledger.zod.ts:1270`), `check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs:156` and `access-security.json:2649` go to 8-post's comment sweep, by name.
- A delta review follows at the new head.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ddcdb46bd44584fac99502c1b49c92d224696a7b`
